content: The Microsoft European Science Award is an annual accolade jointly presented by the Royal Society and the Académie des Sciences. It is specifically awarded to scientists based in Europe who have made significant contributions to the advancement of science through the application of computational methods. The award is sponsored by Microsoft Research. This prize underscores the critical role of interdisciplinary research at the intersection of science and computing in pushing the boundaries of scientific knowledge. It also highlights the importance of investing in European scientists to strengthen Europe’s competitive scientific foundation. The award alternates each year between recognizing achievements in the biological sciences and the physical sciences, which include mathematics and engineering disciplines. The recipient of the award is chosen by a dedicated committee composed of members from the Académie des Sciences and Fellows of the Royal Society. The prize includes a trophy and a monetary award totaling €250,000. Of this amount, €7,500 is allocated as prize money, while the remaining funds are designated to support further research endeavors.
